main_text.p: opponere Defectui authoritatis codicum, idque vocare כנרא, cum quis sine codicum probatorum authoritate & lectione, ex sola sua opinione, judicio, vel ratione, lectionem constantem, receptam & communiorem, erroris redarguere, & aliam lectionem seu in ejus locum substituere, seu illi praeferre conatur. Hinc accommodant etiam huc, & Criticis hujusmodi inculcant, dictum illud Talmudicum, quod legitur in Sota capite tertio: בני הוהר במלאכתך שכלאכתך מלאכת שמים שמא תחסיר או תותיר או ונמצאת מחריב העולם כולו Mi fili, esto cautus in opere tuo, si opus tuum sit opus caeli (h. e. divinum, Sacrum, circa Scripturam sacram versans); quod si enim forte detrahas aut superaddas vel unicam literam, perinde habeberis ac si rastares totum mundum: Item: מי שלח ידו בהם ונקר Quis mi[?]eret manus illis, (ic. codicibus Sacris) & innocens erit? (ad imitationem 1.Sam.26.9.) In Talmud Sanhedrin cap. ult. legitur; כל האומר על או את של תורה אינה מן השמים דבר י' בזו Quicunque etiam de litera unica Legis dicit, quod non sit de caelo, est ex iis de quibus scriptum, Verbum Domini sprevit, Numer. 15. 31. In Megilla cap.3. כל פסוק דלא פסקיה משה אנן לא פסקינן ליה Nullum versum, quem non distinxit Moses nos distinguere debemus, &c.
main_text.head: CAPUT XX.

head.i: Conclusio prima partis, in quâ de Præjudiciis nonnullis, quibus me memo[?] sententiam gravare, se suamo[?] sententiam tutari & communire conatur Defensor.

main_text.p: SIc hactenus, bono cum Deo, sufficienter vindicasse nos existimamus Considerationes nostras, & allegatas ex Hebraeis Authoritates, contra injustam Defensionem Antagonistae nostri, ut Lector videre possit, utra sententia sit verior, turior, certior, & ad Sacrae Scripturae, Hebraicorum praesertim codicum, authentiam & authoritatem conservandam, magis accommodata.

page.notes: Hebrew passages are copied as far as legible; several Hebrew and Latin words in the italic citations are uncertain, especially where the scan is blurred. The decorative rule between the paragraph and the chapter heading is not transcribed. The word "Placuit" at lower right is treated as a catchword.
